feeds.title: Chilled Magazine
feeds.description: Chilled Magazine features new products within the drinking and nightlife community and stories on the founders, distilleries and breweries in the market. Also drink submissions by bartenders, mixologists and readers are also featured here. Follow this site to get to know about everything related to bar industry and latest liquor, beer, wine and drinking products.

feeds.title: A Bar Above Blog
feeds.description: Tips, tricks and techniques for making better craft cocktails at home and behind the pro bar. A Bar Above blog was created in 2012 by Chris Tunstall, a San Francisco Bartender and Mixologist with more than 10 years of experience behind the bar.

feeds.title: Good Spirits News
feeds.description: Blair Frodelius is a professional full-time musician, an award-winning mixologist, USBG Spirits Professional, BarSmarts Live & Wired graduate and member of the Museum of the American Cocktail. Several of his original cocktails can be found in the 75th Anniversary Mr. Boston Official Bartenders Guide, and one inspired by Harry Craddock in the Mixellany publication The Deans of Drink.

feeds.title: Imbibe Magazine » Cocktails + Spirits
feeds.description: Find the best drink recipes, reviews, destinations, and profiles - everything you need to know about the people, places, flavors and culture of drinks around the world. Here you'll find recipes and everything related to cocktail drinks. Imbibe is the ultimate guide to drinks culture.

feeds.title: Mixology News
feeds.description: The Mixology News is essential for the bartender. It is a portal specialized in cocktail and mixology and drinks. It is an effective tool for anyone who wants to know exactly what to drink, where to drink, why to drink and what to drink.

feeds.title: PUNCH
feeds.description: PUNCH is an independent, online magazine in collaboration with Ten Speed Press. They're in the business of narrative journalism - written and visual - on wine, spirits and cocktails, and the culture that surrounds them.

feeds.title: Mix That Drink
feeds.description: Mix That Drink began in the fall of 2008 as a collection of classic, vintage and modern cocktail recipes along with serving suggestions. It is your source for cocktail recipes, craft infusions and bartending tutorials.

feeds.title: Advanced Mixology
feeds.description: Provides the latest trends on Drinks, Food, Dining, Lifestyle, how-to home bar guides, helpful reviews on bar tools and equipment, cocktail recipes, and liquor brand recommendations. Advanced Mixology was started in 2015 with the main goal of providing people with premium quality cocktail, wine and bar accessories without the premium markup.

feeds.title: Tales of the Cocktail Blog
feeds.description: Tales of the Cocktail is the world's premier series of cocktail festivals - highlighting what's now, next, and new in the spirits industry. Browse hundreds of unique, innovative cocktail recipes submitted from bartenders all over the world.

feeds.title: The GastroNom
feeds.description: Jay and Leah Hall aka The 'Noms are the founder of The GastroNom. Leah is a former restaurant manager with over 10 years in the restaurant industry. Jay is an engineer by trade, but has a passion for cooking and mixology. Follow this blog for restaurant reviews, cocktails and recipes, especially craft cocktails and drinks.

feeds.title: Moody Mixologist
feeds.description: Moody Mixologist is a collection of original and classic cocktail recipes, tutorials and photography focused on sharing the beauty of botanical ingredients and exploring unusual syrups, infusions and techniques.

feeds.title: Jeffrey Morgenthaler
feeds.description: Jeffrey Morgenthaler is the bar manager at Clyde Common and Pepe Le Moko in Portland, Oregon, and the co-author of The Bar Book: Elements of Cocktail Technique. He writes about bartending and mixology.

feeds.title: Cocktail Contessa
feeds.description: Learn to make elegant, delicious cocktails at home and impress friends and family with your love of mixology and a little bourbon lore.

feeds.title: Intoxicology
feeds.description: Intoxicology is one couple's mission to experience, share and inspire all things great about spirits through recipes, reviews, news, and event coverage.

feeds.title: Craft and Cocktails
feeds.description: Craft & Cocktails is devoted to the art of making & shaking focusing on original, seasonal & approachable cocktails to make at home.I'm Ashley Rose Conway, a cocktail shaker and piñata maker. I am always in the pursuit of fun and the perfect drink. I work developing recipes, styling, and photographing cocktails as well as creating stories around libations, celebrations, and entertaining.

feeds.title: Cocktail Emporium
feeds.description: BYOB Cocktail Emporium is a one stop shop for all things cocktail related. Browse through hundreds of recipes and get everything you need for it..

feeds.title: A.J. Rathbun Blog
feeds.description: I'm the author of Ginger Bliss & the Violet Fizz, Good Spirits, and other books, the Seattle Magazine Bar Hop columnist and write the blog Spiked Punch. Sip slowly on cocktail recipes, booze news, liqueurs legends and lore, and a heaping helping of party talk.

feeds.title: The Cocktail Lovers
feeds.description: The Cocktail Lovers are Mr G and Ms S, a man and a woman who share a passion for cocktails. The Cocktail Lovers are on a mission to find the best cocktails and cocktail bars in London. From classic cocktails to modern mixology, The Cocktail Lovers.

feeds.title: VinePair
feeds.description: VinePair is a new way to understand and talk about wine, beer and cocktails. VinePair is the best place to learn about wine, beer & spirits. Helpful expert guides, infographics, maps & more make learning about drinking fun and easy.

feeds.title: Doc Elliott's Mixology
feeds.description: I am neither a bartender nor a chef by vocation. Nor have I received any formal training. I am a practicing Anesthesiologist who enjoys good food and craft cocktails.This site is meant to share techniques, recipes and insights with those who enjoy creating great food and drink.

feeds.title: Medium Of Mixology
feeds.description: Medium of Mixology dives into the creation of cocktails from the perspective of a visual artist. For each drink we look at presentation, taste, lasting appeal, and value to reproduce for guests to your home or your business.

feeds.title: Flair Project Blog
feeds.description: Flair Project is a bartending agency offering a variety of bar services. From catering private events to bar consulting, their goal is to be the ambassadors of flair bartending, mixology and excellent customer service. Follow this blog to get inspired with artisan cocktails, bartending trends, amazing drink recipes. Simple, great photography, and fun for your bar enjoyment.

feeds.title: Casual Mixologist
feeds.description: Up your mixology game with actionable guides, cocktail recipes and more for the hobbyist cocktail enthusiast. Learn essential tips and tricks, hear from other at-home mixologists and perfect our craft together.

feeds.title: Two for the Bar
feeds.description: Two For The Bar is a space dedicated to illustrating the magic of shared experience that can occur in the presence of a great cocktail and a talented bartender. These stories and recipes are meant to highlight what I have come to love about craft cocktail culture and perhaps even inspire readers to go and experience it for themselves. Follow this site to get stories from a bartender.

feeds.title: The Natural Mixologist
feeds.description: Marsha specializes in creating cocktails that are classically inspired and updated with modern techniques and exceptional ingredients. The Natural Mixologist creates custom cocktails for your brand, bar, catering, event & hosts mixology classes & molecular mixology: Organic & Gluten-Free

feeds.title: The Liquid Muse Blog
feeds.description: Named one of Four Women Leading the Liquor Industry, Natalie Bovis is an Ambassador of Cocktail Culture. Mixologist, event creator, cocktail book author, educator, and beverage brand owner, Bovis has delved into every aspect of the liquid arts. The Liquid Muse has grown into a trusted consulting, educational, cocktail catering & editorial resource for beverage & spirit companies, etc

feeds.title: Thirsty Camel Cocktails
feeds.description: An Oasis of Cocktail Info for Everyday Life.

feeds.title: Cocktail Bandits
feeds.description: Johnny Caldwell and Taneka Reaves are the dynamic duo known around the globe as the curly-haired Cocktail Bandits. The curly ladies, who talk cocktails daily, educate and entertain their growing blog audience through their own original cocktail recipes, promoting the craftsmanship of other bar professionals and sharing their experiences at foodie events all around the Holy City and beyond.

feeds.title: Frontier Mixology
feeds.description: My name is Nick Dean and this is my blog. The primary focus of Frontier Mixology is simply to post things that interest me, and more specifically — stuff relating to spirits, wine and beer. Tied in with that is my interest in highlighting spirits, bars and mixology in Western New York, which gives this blog sort of a dual focus.

feeds.title: Alchemy & A Twist
feeds.description: Documenting three friends' explorations in the land of libations, from the re-discovery of pre-prohibition classics to experimentation in modern mixology techniques and hand-crafted ingredients.

feeds.title: Mixologists
feeds.description: A site for passionate bartenders and mixologists to connect and share recipes, tips, and advice. Whether you're a professional bartender or just someone who loves to make cocktails at home, mixologists.co is the place for you. Our extensive database of recipes has something for everyone, and our community of users is always happy to help out with advice and tips.

feeds.title: Stir and Strain
feeds.description: Stir and Strain is a cocktail scratch pad that develops and tests cocktails out of a home bar with an emphasis on seasonal, classic, and the occasional Tiki drink thrown in.

feeds.title: Ginhound
feeds.description: I'm a rank amateur at mixing drinks trying to advance myself to merely an amateur. Gin should be my middle name, but I'm trying to understand rum and whisky one cocktail at a time.

feeds.title: Drink Me
feeds.description: Drink Me brings you the entire world of drinks, from the best new spirits to killer wines, craft beers, and everything in between.It has become the go-to resource for drinks professionals and consumers around the world.

feeds.title: Topo Blog
feeds.description: Topo Chico is sparkling mineral water sourced and bottled in Monterrey, Mexico since 1895. Here you'll find different cocktail recipes.

feeds.title: Bartender HQ - Drink Recipes
feeds.description: Established in 2014, BartenderHQ is all about bartenders helping one another to raise the bar in the hospitality industry. Follow this blog for Cocktail recipes, Mixology, Bartender tips and how to earn more money behind the bar.

feeds.title: Vodquila
feeds.description: Red Eye Louie's Vodquila is a special blend of Ultra Premium Vodka and imported Super Premium Tequila. The Vodka is made from multiple grains and distilled SIX times whereas the Tequila is made from Pure Blue Agave Plants and distilled in the Highlands of Jalisco, Mexico.

feeds.title: Hemant Pathak Blog
feeds.description: Hemant Pathak is the Mixologist/Bar Manager of Junoon, an award-winning restaurant in New York redefining Indian gastronomy & elevating it to unprecedented heights. A certified VITI 1 Sommelier from American Sommelier, Hemant also holds advanced certifications in Tequila and Bourbon. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Hotel Management & Tourism from National Institute of Hotel Management.

feeds.title: Cocktails & Bars
feeds.description: Cocktails & Bars is a website dedicated to cocktail culture, bars and spirits. Aimed at the discerning drinker and the cocktail and spirit enthusiast, the site features the best bars, spirit reviews, cocktail recipes, an international bar directory and related news. Launched in 2015, Cocktails & Bars is authored by Corinne Mossati, Founder/Editor of popular online magazine Gourmantic.

feeds.title: Cocktail Builder's Blog
feeds.description: Cocktail Builder's Blog provides tips, tricks and advice for mastering mixology.
